name: labspec
description: Monorepo full stack orientado por Specification-Driven Development

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @labspec/api" "npm run dev -w @labspec/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @labspec/contracts && npm run build -w @labspec/api && npm run build -w @labspec/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @labspec/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @labspec/api && npm run typecheck -w @labspec/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @labspec/api && npm run test -w @labspec/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
